decision: pnpm 11 refuses to run scripts while a build approval is unanswered; answered unrs-resolver false in pnpm-workspace.yaml

why: probe script showed timers and rAF ticking but document.getAnimations currentTime at -26637ms
result: replaced with a real 6s run via ?minutes=0.1

decision: Swallow the click that follows a completed hold in PauseButton (400ms window)
why: Hold completes -> onPause -> pointerup click with detail 1 would call onPlay and resume immediately; long touch presses often emit no click so the flag must expire
evidence: e2e: pause/resume test passes on 3 projects; quick-tap test proves tap does not pause

evidence: new e2e/pwa.spec.ts fetches manifest, each icon, favicon, sw.js -> 200; 36/36 on prod build
